title: Concept type
description: Which of the four groups an approved concept belongs to. A separate record rather than a field on the concept, because the concept was signed by one person on one date and the typing is a second judgement by possibly another — writing it into the signed record would put unsigned content inside a signature (ADR-0071). Shape only: which group a concept belongs in is a legal judgement and no agent may fill `type`.

concept.description: The approved concept this types, by its GC- id. The harness reports a type record naming a concept that is not in the gold set as a dangling cross-reference.

type.description: The group. `ground_of_refusal` — a reason an application can be refused. `legal_test` — a question the decision maker has to answer. `relevant_factor` — something that feeds into that answer. `exception` — something that takes a case out of the rule. `none_of_these` is an answer too, and a real one: it says the four groups do not fit this concept, which is evidence about the taxonomy rather than a gap in the data.

basis.description: The passages the typing rests on, by upstream ref. Optional, because a person who knows the domain may type a concept from knowledge rather than from a passage — but a typing with a basis can be checked and one without cannot, and the coverage report counts the difference.
